name: codex-multi-auth
description: Codex CLI multi-account OAuth manager with account switching, health checks, runtime rotation, diagnostics, and recovery tools for @openai/codex

capability_evidence.multi-account-switching: OpenAI install keeps owning that command.
capability_evidence.auto-failover: pports Global and US endpoints per credential.
capability_evidence.api-gateway: h, including the local real-time web dashboard.
capability_evidence.voice-input: let health- and quota-aware hybrid selection rotate for you.

friction.note_en: Some setup. configure OAuth login flow, sign-in required; GUI application
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。需配置 OAuth login flow、sign-in required；GUI application

analysis.summary_en: codex-multi-auth is a multi-account OAuth manager for the official @openai/codex CLI.
highlights: Account pool — OAuth login for multiple ChatGPT accounts, stored locally under ~/.codex/multi-auth (files 0600, directories 0700), with per-project pools under projects/ /.
Luna Reserve fallback — treats gpt-reserve as a separately metered Luna allowance, automatically falls back after a genuine Luna quota 429, and exposes the Reserve percentage through limits…
API model metadata — login --api can attach operator-declared Daybreak Red access and reasoning efforts to a selected model when discovery omits them.
API capability evidence — opted-in API/ZDR routes receive daily billable checks while the router runs; status distinguishes configured access programs from verified responses.
